# **Annexure-1** 

> **Implementation of Oigilocker** in **Government Departments for Citizen Centric Services** 

This shall be applicable to all Ministries, Departments their attached and subordinate organizations _I_ Autonomous/statutory bodies, Government agencies, educational institutions etc. which would use Digilocker as an issuer, requester and verifier (known as subscriber). 

Departments concerned shall register themselves as mentioned below and may refer the technical documents for the integration of their services with Digilocker. 

- (url:https://partners.digilocker.gov.in) and register as an Issuer, requester or verifier. 

- I. **Registration:** Authorized officials have to visit the 'Partner portal' of Digilocker 

- below link: 

- 2. **Technical resource for integration:** API specification documents are available at 

https://digilocker.gov.in/resource-center.html
